name: Trips saved on the calculator are the ones the EES check compares: 10 days, a 4-day gap to an EES figure of 14

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today and clears saved trips)
Click add trip (data-testid=trip-add), enter 2026-09-01 (data-testid=trip-entry) and 2026-09-10 (data-testid=trip-exit), click save (data-testid=trip-save); one trip row appears
Open exactly /ees?today=2026-10-19 (no fresh=1, which would delete the saved trip)
The empty comparison (data-testid=ees-empty-count) shows 10 and the text 'Your trips: 10 days used.'
Enter 14 in EES days used (data-testid=ees-days-used) and click Compare (data-testid=ees-compare)
The traveller's days (data-testid=ees-traveller-days) show 10 and the figure gap (data-testid=ees-figure-gap) shows 4
